description: Main server entry point that sets up an Express.js web server with security, routing, health checks, error handling, and integrates Socket.IO for real-time communication. It also connects to the database and initializes default admin user.

classes.name: SocketIOServer
classes.description: Socket.IO server class imported from 'socket.io' package, used for real-time WebSocket communication.

methods.name: bootstrap()
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes and starts the Express server with middleware, routes, error handling, Socket.IO, database connection, and default admin setup.
